'''Verken''' was a [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[caliph]], one of several who ruled over various portions of the city [[Thousand Thousand]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. The caliph lived in a palace in the northern portion of the city.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
